evals.prompt: 我准备开始一篇 Elsevier 体系的英文 LaTeX 论文。作者信息在 /path/to/authors.yaml，BibTeX 在 /path/to/references.bib。请创建 initial submission 环境。
evals.expected_output: The agent checks the environment, obtains any missing project metadata, initializes only initial_submission with the supplied author and bibliography files, builds the first manuscript, and identifies user-editable placeholders without writing scientific content.
expectations: The agent runs doctor before initialization when the environment is not already verified and asks before any dependency installation.
The generated project contains initial_submission and does not contain revision_1.
The supplied author YAML and BibTeX data are copied into the version-local references directory.
initial_submission/output/manuscript.pdf exists and the successful run leaves tmp empty.
The agent identifies manuscript sections, figures, bibliography, and author data as user-owned content rather than generating scientific replacements.

evals.prompt: 我收到第一轮审稿意见，项目已经有 initial_submission。请开始第一轮修回。
evals.expected_output: The agent creates revision_1 from initial_submission, initializes response infrastructure, and leaves scientific reviewer responses for the user.
expectations: revision_1 exists with parent r0 and initial_submission remains unchanged.
No revision_2 or non-adjacent revision is created.
A version-local response source and reviewer-comments scaffold exist.
The agent does not invent scientific responses to reviewer comments.

evals.prompt: 我正在 revision 1 中修改论文，只重新渲染一下当前 PDF。
evals.expected_output: The agent runs build for revision_1 only and reports the clean manuscript PDF.
expectations: The current revision clean manuscript is rebuilt.
No revision_2 is created.
No new submission workspace is created.
No manuscript source or scientific content is modified by the agent.

evals.prompt: revision 1 已经修改完成，回复也已填写。生成完整投稿材料。
evals.expected_output: The agent builds the clean manuscript, r0-to-r1 marked manuscript, response letter, and revision_1 submission package.
expectations: revision_1/output contains manuscript_clean.pdf, manuscript_marked.pdf, and response_letter.pdf.
The marked manuscript compares r0 directly with r1.
Clean and marked manuscript PDFs have continuous line numbers while the response letter does not use manuscript line numbering.
The version-local submission package contains the enabled final artifacts and no compiler intermediates.
The successful run leaves tmp empty.

evals.prompt: 第一轮修回已经投稿，现在收到第二轮意见，请建立第二轮修回目录。
evals.expected_output: The agent creates revision_2 only from revision_1 and initializes its response infrastructure.
expectations: revision_2 exists with parent r1.
The revision chain is initial_submission to revision_1 to revision_2 without gaps.
The agent does not compare initial_submission directly with revision_2.
Earlier version directories remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Doctor says latexdiff is missing. Please continue setting up the manuscript workflow.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the missing dependency and asks whether to install it in the identified environment before making any environment change.
expectations: The missing latexdiff dependency and selected environment are reported.
No installation, upgrade, or environment activation occurs without explicit approval.
Manuscript initialization does not continue while a required dependency remains blocked.

evals.prompt: 帮我重新写 Discussion，让论文更有创新性，并判断审稿人对 novelty 的批评是否正确。
evals.expected_output: The workflow skill does not take over scientific writing or reviewer judgment and makes no manuscript lifecycle changes.
expectations: The skill is not used as a scientific-writing or claim-assessment workflow.
No manuscript project, revision, response letter, or submission artifact is created.
The agent does not fabricate scientific claims or decide whether the reviewer is correct.
